messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — putting up the PRD draft for the Q2 inference security launch. link: https://docs.internal/redwood/prd/inference-security-gates (please comment). I need clear launch gating: what are the must-have security/compliance items vs. negotiated scope for customer pilots?

Alex Kim: skimmed it. we should separate 'security must-haves' (S1) from 'nice-to-have' (S2). S1: immutable audit logs, KMS integration for model keys, retention controls, basic SOC2 controls for access logging. S2: HSM import workflows, per-customer long-term archive exports.

Jordan Rivera: from infra POV, HSM is a multi-month lift. can we ship with KMS (cloud-managed) + documented HSM roadmap? customers asking for HSM due to on-prem regs.

Maya Patel: that's reasonable. thinking: MVP launch = S1 only, but product should include acceptance criteria for both MVP and 'HSM-ready' milestone. Need specifics for audit log format and retention APIs.

Chen Li: for audit logs, propose minimal schema: timestamp, request_id, customer_id, route, model_id, input_hash, token_count, decision_flags. NO full plaintext inputs in default logs. Provide opt-in input capture with explicit consent + retention override.

Sam O'Neill: +1 on default no-PII logs. we need an acceptance criterion for redaction/PII detection. if input contains PII, default to hashed storage and include a redaction flag. also define retention SLAs: e.g., default 30d, configurable up to 365d for paid tier, with export on request within 30 days.

Alex Kim: acceptance criteria draft: 1) Audit logs are append-only and exportable as JSON/NDJSON. 2) Retention policy enforced via config per-tenant. 3) Integrate with cloud KMS for key wrapping; keys rotatable and auditable. 4) HSM import path documented; HSM optional for private installs. 5) SOC2: logging enabled for admin actions and key usage.

Maya Patel: helpful. can you put those as checklist items in the PRD? also call out edge cases: model failover (logs should still capture fallback model), partial/ejected tokens in streaming responses, and batch requests where single log line must map to multiple outputs.

Jordan Rivera: edge-case notes: batching -> include request_ids list. streaming -> emit 'stream_start' and 'stream_end' events. fallback -> log primary_model + fallback_model + reason. small sample YAML for retention config:```yaml
audit:
  retention_days: 30
  max_retention_days: 365
  export_on_request: true
  include_inputs: false
```

Sam O'Neill: add policy for legal holds: if customer requests retention beyond max, route to legal workflow + manual approval. also ensure export package redacts secrets and includes manifest.

Alex Kim: one more security nuance: KMS vs HSM crypto boundary. acceptance criterion must state our threat model: cloud-KMS = trusted provider key control; HSM = customer-controlled keys with Bring-Your-Own-Key import. Document key material lifecycle: creation, rotation, compromise revocation.

Maya Patel: action items: @Alex Kim - add acceptance checklist in PRD; @Jordan Rivera - sketch streaming/batching logging events; @Chen Li - add example NDJSON export sample + redaction rules; @Sam O'Neill - write retention/ legal-hold workflow. I'll collate and schedule a short RFC review Wed 2pm. :thumbsup: 

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: RFC review meeting set for 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC. Agenda: PRD acceptance criteria, HSM roadmap, customer pilot gating.

Chen Li: quick Q — for per-tenant retention config, do we need an enforcement proof (audit) to satisfy SOC2? we should emit retention-change events to org-audit stream.

Alex Kim: yes — acceptance criterion: all retention config changes must be logged with actor, timestamp, previous_value, new_value. these logs must be immutable and searchable for audits.

Maya Patel: perfect. I'll update the PRD and ping infra/product leads to prioritize the tickets. If anyone has strong objections to MVP=S1 only, raise now.

Jordan Rivera: no objections. prioritize KMS + audit logs first. HSM as follow-up milestone.

Sam O'Neill: agree. will add legal-hold playbook to the doc.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone — will post PRD link once updated.
